About.title: About me
About.p1: Senior Full-Stack & AI Architect based in South Korea, living and building in the Korean tech ecosystem since 2023. I specialize in taking mission-critical platforms and production AI from zero to scale as an autonomous end-to-end builder — fluent in English, Korean, and Russian.
About.p2: Architected the core backend for Blue Networks' E-Chae-Um EV CSMS across 1,600+ chargers in 500+ locations using Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis, and sharded databases — delivering OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 bidirectional WebSocket telemetry, bulk OTA firmware distribution, and national KECO inter-operator roaming data (로밍 데이터) synchronization with Smartro PG settlements.
About.p3: Engineered the AI-powered EV Power Demand Forecasting & Contract Optimization Platform: combining an 8-model ensemble (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and GEV/GPD Extreme Value Theory) to forecast peak power loads in P50/P90 probabilistic quantiles, significantly reducing KEPCO electricity tariffs and peak surcharge penalties.
About.p4: Today, I specialize in shipping modern AI SaaS platforms, streaming LLM agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), multilingual STT/TTS, and reactive Next.js 15 / TypeScript full-stack architectures containerized across Docker, Linux, AWS, and GCP.

ProjectDetail.role: Senior AI & Full-Stack Architect — EV CSMS, Batch & AI Energy Forecasting
ProjectDetail.title: Blue Networks: E-Chae-Um & AI Power Demand Forecasting Platform
ProjectDetail.summary: Enterprise EV Charging Station Management System (CSMS) managing 1,600+ chargers across Korea and an 8-model AI ensemble platform (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, EVT) delivering probabilistic P50/P90 power demand forecasts to optimize KEPCO contracted capacity and eliminate peak surcharge penalties.
ProjectDetail.problemText: Delivering sub-second bidirectional telemetry across 1,600+ fast and slow EV chargers in 500+ locations in Korea, executing safe bulk OTA firmware updates without network saturation, synchronizing inter-CPO roaming data with the Ministry of Environment (KECO), and preventing 1.5x peak power penalty surcharges from KEPCO.
ProjectDetail.solutionText: Engineered high-concurrency OCPP 1.6-J / 2.0.1 bidirectional WebSocket gateways via BNCPOs (Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis), automated KECO national roaming and Smartro PG payment reconciliation via BNCPOsBatch, operator monitoring via BNCPOsWebApp, and an 8-model AI ensemble power demand forecasting platform (power-demand-platform-v2) using PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and Extreme Value Theory (EVT GEV/GPD).
ProjectDetail.overviewP1: Blue Networks (kblue.co.kr) is Korea's premier EV charging infrastructure and IoT solution provider, operating over 1,600 charging stations under the E-Chae-Um brand nationwide. As Senior Full-Stack & AI Architect, I designed, implemented, and scaled 4 core production sub-systems: BNCPOs, BNCPOsBatch, BNCPOsWebApp, and power-demand-platform-v2.
ProjectDetail.overviewP2: 1. BNCPOs (Core CSMS & Admin Control Server): Built with Java 17, Spring Boot, and MyBatis. Delivers high-throughput bidirectional WebSocket telemetry on OCPP 1.6J and OCPP 2.0.1 protocols. Enables remote station control (RemoteStart, RemoteStop, Reset, UnlockConnector, Diagnostics), modem diagnostics, and time-staggered bulk OTA firmware rollouts to prevent network congestion. Dashboard performance was dramatically enhanced via Redis clustering and 23:50 daily aggregations.
ProjectDetail.overviewP3: 2. BNCPOsBatch & BNCPOsWebApp: BNCPOsBatch manages automated inter-operator roaming data pipelines with the Korea Environment Corporation (KECO), reconciles Smartro PG payment transactions, and runs automated daily billing settlements. BNCPOsWebApp serves as the real-time operational dashboard for monitoring charging sessions, charger health, and analytics.
ProjectDetail.overviewP4: 3. power-demand-platform-v2 (AI Power Demand Forecasting & KEPCO Cost Optimizer): An AI-driven forecasting platform engineered with FastAPI (Python), PyTorch, XGBoost, and SvelteKit. Combines an 8-model ensemble (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and Extreme Value Theory GEV/GPD) to forecast daily median expected demand (P50) and top-10% critical peak load (P90) with an 80% confidence band. Generates optimal KEPCO contracted power recommendations, eliminating 1.5x peak surcharge penalties.
capabilities: Bidirectional WebSocket live telemetry across 1,600+ chargers via OCPP 1.6-J & 2.0.1 protocols
Network-safe staggered OTA bulk firmware distribution (Bulk Firmware Update)
National KECO inter-operator roaming data synchronization
Smartro PG payment reconciliation and automated billing batch pipelines
8-model AI ensemble (PyTorch LSTM + XGBoost + EVT GEV/GPD) for power demand forecasting
P50 and P90 quantile probability modeling with KEPCO contract capacity optimization
High-throughput Redis caching, sharded MySQL/PostgreSQL, and resilient microservice architecture
